The '''''Verpine''''' was an [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Ardent-class fast frigate|''Ardent''-class fast frigate]] that fought at the [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Second Imperial Civil War)|Battle of Mon Calamari]] in [[137 ABY]].

==History==
[[File:Outer_Rim_Third_Fleet.jpg|thumb|left|150px|The ''Verpine'' was part of the [[Outer Rim Third Fleet]].]]
The ''Verpine'' served in the [[Outer Rim Third Fleet]], and was part of the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] effort to destroy the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] forces under [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]].

It was heavily damaged in combat over [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]].
